## Description

A planar face with a rectangular hole. The FACE_OUTER_BOUND's loop is traversed clockwise (when viewed from the surface's positive side), while the inner FACE_BOUND is traversed counter-clockwise. Both loops close, both are simple, but the inside/outside semantics of the face are swapped: the kernel "sees" material where the producer intended a hole, and a hole where the producer intended material. Kernel accepts the file silently; tier-3 introspection (signed area of each loop relative to the face's surface normal) reveals outer and inner are reversed.

## Reproducer recipe

Plane at z=0 (10x10 outer rectangle, 4x4 inner hole). Outer loop visits corners CW seen from +Z. Inner loop visits corners CCW. Wrap as ADVANCED_FACE / OPEN_SHELL / SHELL_BASED_SURFACE_MODEL / MANIFOLD_SURFACE_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION.

## Expected kernel behavior

Verify loop orientations against the face surface normal — outer loops CCW, inner loops CW (or whatever convention the kernel chooses), and either flip non-conforming loops, reject the face, or report the inversion. Should not silently produce a face whose point-membership predicate is the complement of the producer's intent.
